ShelfGuard AI — Test Strategy & Test Cases Specification

Enterprise Computer Vision Copilot, SDLC Traceability, and Non-Blocking Ingestion Pipeline Test Architecture

1. Test Strategy Summary

1.1 Scope

The scope encompasses end-to-end functional verification, non-blocking asynchronous queuing behavior, computer vision timeout handling (2,500ms SLA), graceful degradation mechanisms, optimistic concurrency control (version locking), database DDL constraints, role-based access control (RBAC), transport encryption (TLS 1.3), data privacy masking, and the automated Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) engine.

1.2 Objectives

  • Validate that asynchronous payload ingestion correctly processes multipart uploads and returns immediate `202 Accepted` queue tokens.
  • Ensure strict adherence to computer vision processing constraints, including 2,500ms timeout boundaries and fallback synthetic event loading.
  • Verify absolute data integrity under race conditions using SQL optimistic locking (`WHERE version = :v`) during store manager approvals.
  • Guarantee robust security enforcement across RBAC roles, facial anonymization pre-processing, and append-only audit log immutability.

1.3 Entry Criteria

  • Approved functional specification (`spec_v2.md`) and database DDL schema.
  • Successful deployment of the test environment containers and initial seed datasets (`products.csv`, `inventory.csv`, `planogram.csv`, `shelf_events.csv`).
  • Passing static code analysis and schema validation reports.

1.4 Exit Criteria

  • 100% execution of P1 (Critical) and P2 (High) test cases with 0 unmitigated defects.
  • Automated test suite passing rate ≥ 98% across unit, integration, and security suites.
  • Complete mapping verification across all RTM nodes (`REQ-001` through `REQ-008`).

1.5 Test Approach & Levels

A multi-layered test pyramid approach is enforced:

  • Unit Testing: Isolated validation of detection algorithms, database schema constraints, and priority scoring functions.
  • Integration Testing: API endpoint verification, asynchronous worker queue dispatching, and relational cross-referencing against planograms and inventories.
  • System & End-to-End (E2E) Testing: Simulated store associate uploads through manager approval workflows and impact dashboard snapshot aggregations.
  • Non-Functional Testing: Security penetration checks, TLS 1.3 verification, concurrency race-condition testing, and CV timeout resiliency testing.

1.6 Defect Management & Risk Matrix

  • Defect Severity Levels: P1-Blocker (System crash, data corruption, security bypass), P2-Critical (Core feature failure without workaround, CV timeout violation), P3-Major (UI metric drift, minor validation discrepancy), P4-Minor (Cosmetic formatting).
  • Key Risks & Mitigations:
    • Risk: CV inference latency exceeding 2,500ms window during peak hours.
      Mitigation: Automated graceful degradation fallback testing injecting pre-seeded synthetic anomalies.
    • Risk: Race conditions during simultaneous store manager approvals.
      Mitigation: Rigorous concurrency testing targeting optimistic locking version increments and HTTP 409 responses.

2. Test Environment

Environment Name Build Version Database Engine Key Dependencies & Configuration
QA Staging (E2E) v2.0.4-rc1 PostgreSQL 15 (AES-256 Enabled) LangGraph Agent Runtime, Celery Worker Queue, Redis Broker, JWT Auth Service
Automated CI Pipeline v2.0.4-ci SQLite In-Memory (Test Isolation) Pytest, Testcontainers, Mock VLM Engine, Synthetic Dataset Seed Files
Security & Performance Lab v2.0.4-perf PostgreSQL 15 (Encrypted Storage) Locust Load Testing Framework, OWASP ZAP Scanner, TLS 1.3 Termination Proxies

3. High-Level Test Scenarios (Grouped by Module)

Module 1: Ingestion & Upload (REQ-001)

  • TS-ING-01: Valid multipart shelf image upload & queue initialization.
  • TS-ING-02: File size and dimension boundary validation checks.
  • TS-ING-03: Zone ID validation against active planograms.

Module 2: Computer Vision & Fallback (REQ-002)

  • TS-CV-01: Successful bounding box detection within 2,500ms SLA.
  • TS-CV-02: Graceful degradation fallback on inference timeout (>2,500ms).
  • TS-CV-03: Low confidence threshold fallback (<0.70 confidence).

Module 3: Cross-Reference & Scoring (REQ-003, REQ-004)

  • TS-REF-01: Planogram facing and backroom inventory relational cross-matching.
  • TS-REF-02: Priority scoring algorithm verification (HIGH vs. MEDIUM).
  • TS-REF-03: Point-in-time financial snapshot capture.

Module 4: Approvals & Audit (REQ-005, REQ-006, REQ-007, REQ-008)

  • TS-GOV-01: Optimistic locking concurrency enforcement (HTTP 409 Conflict).
  • TS-GOV-02: Immutable audit logging on state transitions.
  • TS-GOV-03: RTM traceability chain verification.

4. Detailed Test Cases Matrix

TC ID Req ID Module Feature Priority Test Type Objective Preconditions Test Data Steps Expected Result Actual Result Status Executed By Execution Date Automation Defect ID Comments
TC-001 REQ-001 Ingestion Multipart Upload P1 - High Functional Verify valid shelf image upload returns 202 Accepted and QUEUED token. Active JWT token, valid zone ID in planogram. Image: shelf_bay_3.jpg (1.8MB, 1920x1080), Zone: "Aisle-3-Bay-2", Associate: "EMP-1092". 1. POST to `/api/v1/shelf/analyze`
2. Attach multipart payload & headers.
3. Inspect HTTP response status & body.		 HTTP 202 Accepted. JSON contains unique `image_id`, polling URI, and status `QUEUED`. TBD Not Run — — Automated — Core ingestion path.
TC-002 REQ-001 Ingestion Payload Size Check P2 - Med Negative Verify payload exceeding 10MB limit is rejected. Active JWT token. Image: oversized_shelf.png (12.4MB). 1. POST to `/api/v1/shelf/analyze` with oversized image.
2. Check response code.		 HTTP 413 Payload Too Large. TBD Not Run — — Automated — Resource protection.
TC-003 REQ-001 Ingestion Zone Validation P2 - Med Negative Verify invalid zone ID returns 400 Bad Request. Active JWT token. Zone ID: "Invalid-Zone-999". 1. POST to `/api/v1/shelf/analyze` with non-existent zone.
2. Check response code.		 HTTP 400 Bad Request. TBD Not Run — — Automated — Integrity check.
TC-004 REQ-002 CV Engine Timeout & Degradation P1 - High Resiliency Verify graceful degradation fallback loads synthetic records when CV inference times out. CV model mock configured to delay >2,500ms. Image ID: `img_timeout_test`. 1. Trigger analysis.
2. Simulate CV timeout (>2500ms).
3. Inspect background worker logs and generated events.		 System triggers fallback mechanism, loading pre-seeded synthetic anomaly records from `shelf_events.csv`. TBD Not Run — — Automated — SLA compliance.
TC-005 REQ-002 CV Engine Confidence Threshold P2 - Med Functional Verify low confidence score triggers synthetic fallback. CV model returning confidence = 0.55. Image ID: `img_low_conf`. 1. Process image ingestion.
2. Evaluate detected confidence score.		 Confidence < 0.70 triggers synthetic fallback records. TBD Not Run — — Automated — Quality threshold.
TC-006 REQ-003 Inventory Cross-Reference P1 - High Integration Verify detected SKUs correctly cross-reference planogram and inventory tables. Database seeded with test SKUs, planogram, and inventory. Detected SKU: `SKU-OAT-01`, Zone: `Aisle-3-Bay-2`. 1. Execute cross-reference service.
2. Query enriched event object.		 Returns stock differential, expected vs actual facing count, and backroom availability boolean. TBD Not Run — — Automated — Core business logic.
TC-007 REQ-004 Recommendation Priority Scoring P1 - High Functional Verify high-priority recommendation is assigned when on-shelf qty is 0 and backroom qty > 0. Inventory record with `on_shelf_qty = 0`, `backroom_qty = 15`. SKU: `SKU-MILK-02`. 1. Run recommendation synthesis engine.
2. Inspect generated priority and recommendation text.		 Assigns `Priority: HIGH`, Recommendation: `"Refill from backroom"`, capturing point-in-time financial snapshot. TBD Not Run — — Automated — Algorithmic accuracy.
TC-008 REQ-005 Approval Gate Optimistic Locking P1 - High Concurrency Verify optimistic locking prevents race conditions and returns 409 Conflict on version mismatch. Event ID `EVT-9001` with `version = 1`. Approver: `MGR-402`, Decision: `APPROVED`, Expected Version: `0` (stale). 1. POST approval request with stale version `0`.
2. Inspect HTTP response status.		 HTTP 409 Conflict returned. Database version remains unchanged. TBD Not Run — — Automated — Data consistency.
TC-009 REQ-005 Approval Gate Audit Logging P1 - High Governance Verify successful approval writes immutable entry to `audit_logs` table. Event ID `EVT-9001` with `version = 1`, `STORE_MANAGER` JWT token. Approver: `MGR-402`, Decision: `APPROVED`, Expected Version: `1`. 1. POST valid approval request.
2. Query `audit_logs` table for latest entry matching event ID.		 New immutable audit log row created with correct timestamp, actor ID, role, prior state hash, and payload snapshot. TBD Not Run — — Automated — Compliance mandate.
TC-010 REQ-007 Traceability RTM Retrieval P2 - Med API Verify traceability matrix endpoint correctly maps requirement ID to code modules, ADRs, and tests. Traceability table seeded. Requirement ID: `REQ-002`. 1. GET `/api/v1/traceability/REQ-002`.
2. Inspect JSON response schema.		 Returns JSON containing requirement description, user story, ADR reference, code modules, test cases, and evidence artifacts. TBD Not Run — — Automated — SDLC governance.

5. Negative Test Cases

TC ID Module Scenario Description Test Input Expected Result
NEG-01 Ingestion Invalid file extension upload (.txt instead of .jpg/.png) File: `shelf_scan.txt`, Zone: `Aisle-1-Bay-1` HTTP 400 Bad Request (Unsupported file format).
NEG-02 Approval Store Associate attempting Store Manager approval action Role: `STORE_ASSOCIATE`, Endpoint: `POST /api/v1/shelf/events/{id}/approve` HTTP 403 Forbidden (Insufficient permissions).
NEG-03 Inventory Negative inventory update attempt violating database CHECK constraints SQL: `UPDATE inventory SET on_shelf_qty = -5 WHERE sku_id = 'SKU-01'` Database Integrity Exception (CHECK constraint violation `on_shelf_qty >= 0`).

6. Boundary Test Cases

TC ID Module Boundary Parameter Test Value Expected Result
BND-01 Ingestion Image Resolution Lower Bound Resolution: $799 \times 599$ pixels Rejected with HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity (Below minimum $800 \times 600$ requirement).
BND-02 Ingestion Image Resolution Exact Lower Bound Resolution: $800 \times 600$ pixels Accepted successfully (HTTP 202 Queued).
BND-03 CV Engine Confidence Score Boundary Confidence: `0.699` vs `0.700` `0.699` triggers synthetic fallback; `0.700` proceeds with live inference parsing.

7. Security Test Cases

TC ID Security Domain Test Objective Attack Vector / Method Expected Result
SEC-01 Transport Security Verify TLS 1.3 enforcement and plaintext rejection Attempt HTTP connection to API gateway (`http://api.shelfguard.ai/`) Connection refused or redirected to HTTPS; plaintext HTTP strictly disabled.
SEC-02 Data Privacy Verify facial anonymization pre-processing filter Upload test shelf image containing human facial features Image pre-processing strips/masks faces prior to permanent storage; raw unmasked images not retained.
SEC-03 Synthetic Isolation Verify isolation of hackathon mock data pipelines Inspect database connection strings and environment configurations Strict adherence to `products.csv`, `inventory.csv`, and `planogram.csv`; zero production CCTV or PII ingestion.

8. Performance Test Cases

TC ID Performance Metric Load Profile SLA Threshold Expected Result
PERF-01 CV Processing Latency Concurrent ingestion of 50 simultaneous shelf bay images Strict ≤ 2,500ms timeout per inference job All inference jobs complete within 2,500ms window or trigger graceful degradation fallback without thread blocking.
PERF-02 API Gateway Throughput 100 requests/sec multipart upload load test over 10 minutes Response time p95 < 200ms for initial `202 Accepted` queue response Gateway scales asynchronously, returning `202 Accepted` tokens instantly without dropping connections.

9. Test Execution Suites

Smoke Test Suite

Purpose: Rapid sanity check post-deployment.

  • TC-001 (Multipart Upload & 202 Accepted)
  • TC-006 (Inventory Cross-Reference)
  • SEC-01 (TLS 1.3 Verification)

Sanity Test Suite

Purpose: Targeted validation of recent bug fixes.

  • TC-004 (CV Timeout & Degradation)
  • TC-008 (Optimistic Locking & HTTP 409)
  • TC-010 (RTM Traceability Endpoint)

Full Regression Suite

Purpose: Comprehensive end-to-end verification prior to release sign-off.

  • Encompasses all Test Cases (TC-001 through TC-010), Negative Tests (NEG-01 to NEG-03), Boundary Tests (BND-01 to BND-03), Security Tests (SEC-01 to SEC-03), and Performance Tests (PERF-01 to PERF-02).

10. User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Scenarios

UAT ID Persona Business Workflow Acceptance Criteria
UAT-01 Store Associate Capture and submit daily shelf bay audit Associate successfully uploads aisle photograph via mobile/web interface, receives queue confirmation, and views generated task on floor dashboard.
UAT-02 Store Manager Review and approve high-priority restocking work order Manager reviews out-of-stock alert with point-in-time financial snapshot, verifies backroom stock, and successfully approves task, dispatching replenishment work order.
UAT-03 Retail IT / AI Governance Audit trail and traceability inspection Auditor verifies append-only audit log entries and inspects live RTM mapping requirements to ADRs, source code, and test artifacts.
